lines.en: My wing tips graze the treetops
I glide low over the slope
I walk a stretch on all fours
My wings stay folded at my sides
I skim past the ridge
I ride the warm air
My shadow sweeps the grass
I hop from tree to tree
I beat my wings twice
I circle one ridge
I rise above the canopy
I glide on the slope wind
I spring off the rock
I skim across an open stretch
I perch on a dead branch
I fold my wings tight
Fine lines mark my beak
I watch the forest floor from above
I turn my head slowly

lines.zh: 山风从我的翼膜下穿过。
lines.en: Mountain wind slips beneath my wing membrane.
The mountain wind lifts my feathers
I wait for a rising current
My claws grip the bark
I have no wish to come down
I look down at my shadow
I open my beak and close it
I rub my beak on the branch
I look deep into the valley
I look down at you
Your head rises slowly
My wings open a little
You are standing under me
I tilt my head your way
You are seldom looked at from above
I screech down at you
I flap once more
I tilt my head along your line
I beat my wings to gain distance
I wobble and steady
A few feathers are gone
That knocked me off line
I glance at the hurt
I land on a branch and press it
I flap my wings once
Two beats and I am up
I pull up a little
That did not stop me
You hold meat up
I beat my wings and look down
That piece is far too small
Let me try one dive
I circle once above your head

lines.zh: 我盘旋着，等你多丢几块。
lines.en: I circle, waiting for you to toss more.
I settle back on the branch
I drop a block lower
I reach a claw for it
You hit my wing bone
My wing sweeps you aside
My wing bones are light and hard
I beat upward to lift clear
I land only after you move back
That is not enough to harm me
My wing beats the grass flat
I land on the branch and sway
I fold my wings once you step back
There are others beyond the ridge

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一股热气流
lines.en: We ride the same thermal
She circles above me
We call across the valley
We glide over the ridge together
I am in no rush for that
She headed toward the clouds
We share one ridge
When she calls, I listen first
I dive and snatch it up
It is too heavy to lift
It slips out of my claws
I drop it on the branch
I tilt my head at it
I cannot hold such things
Too heavy, I cannot lift it
I drop it back down
You are beneath me
My wings have opened
I have my dive line
My shadow finds you first
Looking up will not be in time
I fold my wings to drop
This stoop comes easily
You stand too near the trees
I will come down behind you
My claws spread
You cannot see this side of me
I am very close now
I spiral downward
You ducked behind a tree
I pass over the treetops
No hurry, I have the wind
Run a bit more and you are in the open
I keep my eyes on your motion
I beat my wings once again

lines.zh: 这一片树挡不住我的视线
lines.en: These trees do not block my sight
Turning slows you down
I narrow my wings
The mountain wind lifts me
Can you hear my wings
I come a little lower
You have left the shade
I wait for you to be alone
I sweep across above your head

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候我在你左侧
lines.en: I am on your left when you look up
I dive and claw you
My claws lock onto your shoulder
My beak strikes your brow
I buffet you with a wing

lines.zh: 我抓了你一下就升起来
lines.en: I claw once and pull up
You stagger a step
My claws rake your back
I dive a second time
That blow carried my descent
You raise an arm and it is caught
I beat my wings and hop
My wing buffets your cheek
I claw once and rise
My beak jabs your shoulder
I bump you as I land
A shape sweeps the canopy
I come in from the ridge
My shadow crosses the grass first
Wings sound overhead
I drop from beneath the clouds
The wind fills my wings
I perch on a treetop and look
I bank downward in a spiral
My claws release the branch
The air parts under my wings
I halt overhead

lines.zh: 我落在离你不远的石上
lines.en: I light on a stone near you
The mountain wind is still in my feathers
I launch from the cliff edge
Fire licks my wing edge
I land on the slope and roll
Soaked through, I cannot lift
The blast blows me off course
Magic stiffens one wing
Flying long, and nothing caught
Lightning bursts on my wing
I drop straight down
